programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete answers the call of duty to build a tree house in Pennsylvania that focuses on the children of Marines; cargo netting off the deck provides an exciting way to enter, while even more nets inside form a bridge to access a private loft space.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete makes a treehouse touchdown in Pittsburgh for Antonio Brown, wide receiver for the Pittsburgh Steelers; his plan is to build a luxury skybox with a two-story window wall that overlooks a custom basketball court and football field.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete tackles the first climb-in movie theater; concessions are served to seating pods through a pulley system and loungers elevate into the trees to give perfect views of the big screen; a tree house for monkeys at the Los Angeles Zoo.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete partners up in Utopia, Texas, for his first joint venture: a tree house bed-and-breakfast built for romance; a French-inspired chapel of love has a 25-foot steeple and the biggest bathroom Pete has built to date.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete Nelson seeks out the most wonderful arboreal structures in the world, highlighting how each has been swayed by different artistic movements, while also appreciating function and form.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete's fun-loving friend is the lucky recipient of a treehouse built strictly for good times; the team builds a dream of a treehouse complete with a wine bar, a loft, and their first-ever hot tub in the woods of Western Washington.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Taking a look back at builds from the past is always a joy for Pete Nelson and the carpenters of NT&S; Pete and a few crew members gather around the campfire to poke fun at one another about the shenanigans they shared when building in the trees.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: A friend of Pete's has the tree house bug and decides to open a tree house B&B; the classic A-Frame structure has all the amenities and a waterfall that pours from the wraparound deck to the pond below.
